description: Power System Data Model - A data model for the description of electrical power systems is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Institute of Electrical Power Systems and High Voltage Engineering - TU Dresden. IEEH Power System Data Model provides a schema to describe the elements of an electrical power system. It provides a hierarchical structure/schema to describe unique entity relations as well as parameter sets. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is BSD-3-Clause. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
